propositions: Seven detection kinds (lock, env_var, config_key, feature_flag, ci_gate, autouse_fixture, test_helper) partition the mechanism surface so each definition site yields exactly one (kind, name) entry with no overlap.

config_key and feature_flag names must be section-qualified as <section>.<key> in baseline to distinguish same-named keys across _SECTIONS; feature_flag claims boolean-coerced entries and config_key claims non-boolean remainder.

Justified exceptions use in-tree markers (# mechanism-ok: <kind> <name> — <reason>) parsed by the script; marker placement varies by detection shape (definition line, string literal, filename glob, or YAML step).
--check mode detects unjustified new mechanisms and exits non-zero; --update-stale refuses to write when new or increased mechanisms exist.

Baseline file .github/mechanism-baseline.json uses schema shape {"schema_version": 1, "mechanisms": {"<kind>::<name>": 1}} with sorted keys and validated UTF-8, porting complexity baseline's compare() and has_regression logic.

Script ships under scripts/ as modular detectors split by input surface (AST, config registry, globs+YAML) and measures only src/rebar production scope to stay within per-module 800-LOC and per-function complexity-15 limits.
